title: ql_report.conflict_mrs picks the list's fields by the url's forge, not the forge setting bl_forge.read_list now aims at
goal: ql_report.conflict_mrs reads the fields of the list by the forge the list was read from (the forge setting, else the url's), so a GitHub Enterprise host named by forge github lists its conflict merge requests, and the repro exits 0

run: import json,os,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); c=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"backlog.json"); json.dump({"forge":"github"},open(c,"w")); os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG"]=c; import ql_report; run=lambda a,cwd=None:(0,json.dumps([{"number":3,"title":"t","headRefName":"querylog/r1","url":"u"}]),""); d,_=ql_report.conflict_mrs("https://ghe.corp.example.com/group/kb.git",run); sys.exit(0 if d and d[0][0]=="#3" else 1)
